name: Opportunity — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Opportunity from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Opportunity" but are not part of the Opportunity entry, which is unchanged.

School: divination; Level: cleric 5

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: V, S

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 5 rounds

DESCRIPTION

You are briefly able to precisely determine your own fate.

One time per round for the duration of the spell you may reroll one of the following types of checks 3 times and take whichever roll you like (you may choose a different option each round):

one attack roll, or
one saving throw, or
one ability check, or
one skill check.
